title: Grateful Dead Live at Pacific Recording Studios on 1969-06-20
lineage: A>D transfer: Linn LP12/Lingo turntable, Linn Ittok tonearm, Lyra Helikon cartridge,PS Audio PCA-2 preamplifier, M Audio Audiophile USB external, A/C powered sound card
source: Ampex 16-track tape > LP > 24-bit, 44.1 kHz WAV > 16-bit, 44.1 kHz WAV > SHN

ai_review.summary: High‑quality streaming of the original 1969 Aoxomoxoa mix with crisp studio sound and standout tracks like “What’s Become of the Baby” and “China Cat Sunflower”.
ai_review.review: Listeners overwhelmingly praise this upload as the authentic 1969 studio mix, noting it sounds clearer and more dynamic than the later 1971 remix.  The recording is clean with only minor LP‑derived pops at the end of “China Cat Sunflower”, making it an excellent reference for fans seeking the original psychedelic texture.

ai_rating.rationale: The majority of reviews (10+) are 4‑5 stars and highlight superior sound quality and favorite album moments; only a few low‑star comments dispute its relevance, so the overall rating is strongly positive.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Original 1969 studio mix, crisp and balanced; minor LP surface noise/pops at the end of “China Cat Sunflower”; praised as superior to the 1971 remix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Album flow retains its original psychedelic arc; listeners note the mix captures the period’s “insane glory” and tight sequencing.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s tone is highlighted as vivid and more authentic in this original mix.
